shard_17_api_infrastructure.@name: API Infrastructure Shard - Virtual REST Server & Marketplace
shard_17_api_infrastructure.@description: INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER: Virtual REST server with dynamic routing + user-defined API provider marketplace. Transforms ASX from 'collection of tools' into 'platform economy'.

significance.paradigm_shift: Upgrades architecture from 'local logic' to 'global microservice platform'
enables: Users can define & host their own APIs
significance.comparison: Decentralized Firebase + Vercel + Stripe + OpenAI — but user-owned

dynamic_routing: Method-based routing (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)
api_proxy_gateway: Proxy requests to registered provider APIs

/health.returns: Shard status, version, route count, provider count

/providers/register.params: id, name, url, category, description, priceTokens, public
/providers/register.returns: Registers user API as marketplace provider

/providers/call.returns: Proxies request to provider API, returns response

provider_registration_flow.step_1: User creates their own API (any hosting: GAS, Vercel, custom server)
provider_registration_flow.step_2: User registers API via POST to /providers/register with metadata
provider_registration_flow.step_4: Provider appears in marketplace listing at /providers
provider_registration_flow.step_5: Other users can call provider via /providers/call with providerId
provider_registration_flow.step_6: System tracks owner, pricing, public/private status

provider_metadata.id: Unique provider ID (auto-generated if not provided)
provider_metadata.name: Provider display name (required)
provider_metadata.url: API endpoint URL (required, auto-normalized to https://)
provider_metadata.priceTokens: Cost in ASX tokens per call (default: 0)
provider_metadata.owner: Google account email of provider owner

api_proxy_features.method_forwarding: Forwards GET, POST, PUT, PATCH to provider
api_proxy_features.query_params: Parameters starting with q_* are forwarded (q_userId → userId)
api_proxy_features.body_forwarding: JSON bodies are parsed and forwarded for POST/PUT/PATCH
api_proxy_features.response_capture: Captures HTTP status, headers, raw body, parsed JSON
api_proxy_features.error_handling: Returns structured error on provider failure

platform_economy_enablement.user_owned_apis: Users host APIs anywhere, register them, get paid
platform_economy_enablement.token_pricing: Each provider sets priceTokens for their API
platform_economy_enablement.api_chaining: Providers can call other providers, creating compositions
platform_economy_enablement.monetization: Foundation for billing users based on provider token costs
platform_economy_enablement.decentralization: APIs owned by users, not platform

future_layers: auth.gs → API keys + per-route access control
infrastructure_foundation.purpose: Foundation for API economy and user-owned cloud functions

integration.specialist_shards: Specialists can register as providers, exposing their capabilities to marketplace
integration.mx2lm_orchestration: MX2LM can route to providers, meter usage, bundle APIs into products
integration.mesh_network: Providers can be hosted on P2P mesh or centralized servers
integration.token_economy: Integrates with ASX token system for provider pricing

use_cases: User registers their own API as marketplace provider
Platform routes traffic to user APIs with metering
Multiple APIs chained into orchestrated products
Users discover and consume public APIs
